name: SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria)
description: AICPA Trust Services Criteria for Security (Common Criteria). Descriptions are paraphrased.

controls.title: Integrity and ethical values
controls.description: The organization demonstrates commitment to integrity and ethical values, including documented policies the workforce acknowledges.
controls.evidence_guidance: Published code of conduct / infosec policy with acknowledgment records.

checks.rationale: An active, acknowledged information-security policy demonstrates the documented commitment CC1.1 expects.

controls.title: Internal and external information quality
controls.description: The organization obtains and uses relevant, quality information to support internal control functioning.
controls.evidence_guidance: Security telemetry: scan results, asset data, audit logs feeding decisions.

checks.rationale: Recent attack-surface discovery shows the organization is generating quality security information.
An operative audit log supports information quality for internal control.

controls.title: Risk identification and assessment
controls.description: The organization identifies risks to objectives and analyzes them as a basis for managing risk.
controls.evidence_guidance: Annual risk assessment plus continuous technical risk identification (scans).

checks.rationale: A documented annual risk assessment is the primary CC3.2 artifact.
Recurring vulnerability scans provide continuous technical risk identification.

controls.title: Ongoing monitoring evaluations
controls.description: The organization selects and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations of internal control components.
controls.evidence_guidance: Continuous scanning schedules and monitoring configuration.

checks.rationale: An active recurring scan schedule is direct evidence of ongoing monitoring.
Completed recent discovery runs prove monitoring is operating, not just configured.

controls.title: Technology general controls
controls.description: The organization selects and develops general control activities over technology to support objectives.
controls.evidence_guidance: Access control policy plus enforced role-based access.

checks.rationale: A published access-control policy defines the general control activity.
Role-based membership with recorded changes shows the control operating.

controls.title: Logical access security
controls.description: The organization implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets.
controls.evidence_guidance: Asset inventory identifying protected assets, plus access management records.

checks.rationale: CC6.1 requires identifying protected information assets — the maintained shared asset inventory is that identification.
Recorded role assignments and changes evidence logical access management.

controls.title: User registration and authorization
controls.description: New internal and external users are registered and authorized prior to being issued credentials, and access is removed when no longer required.
controls.evidence_guidance: Membership lifecycle records (invites, role grants, removals) in the audit trail.

checks.rationale: Member invite/role-change/removal events in the audit log directly evidence the registration and deprovisioning lifecycle.

controls.title: Unauthorized software prevention and detection
controls.description: The organization implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
controls.evidence_guidance: Vulnerability scanning detecting exposed/vulnerable software plus remediation.

checks.rationale: Recurring scans detect vulnerable and unauthorized software on assets.
Acting upon detections is evidenced by no critical findings left open.

controls.title: Vulnerability identification
controls.description: The organization uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that introduce vulnerabilities, and susceptibility to newly discovered vulnerabilities.
controls.evidence_guidance: Completed vulnerability scans across the asset base.

checks.rationale: Completed scan runs are the direct artifact of vulnerability identification.
Identification must cover the asset base, not a single host — coverage % proves breadth.

controls.title: Anomaly monitoring
controls.description: The organization monitors system components and their operation for anomalies indicating malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors.
controls.evidence_guidance: Continuous monitoring schedules operating against the environment.

checks.rationale: Active recurring schedules evidence continuous (not point-in-time) monitoring.
Recent completed discovery proves the monitoring actually runs.

controls.title: Security incident response
controls.description: The organization responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program.
controls.evidence_guidance: Incident response policy plus remediation lifecycle records.

checks.rationale: A published, acknowledged IR policy is the defined program CC7.4 requires.
High/critical findings remediated within SLA evidence the response program executing.

controls.title: Incident recovery
controls.description: The organization identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

checks.rationale: Recovery is proven when remediated findings are verified by a subsequent rescan.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: The organization authorizes, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.
controls.evidence_guidance: Change/audit trail showing tracked administrative changes.

checks.rationale: The append-only audit trail of administrative changes evidences change tracking.

controls.title: Vendor and business partner risk management
controls.description: The organization assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.

checks.rationale: Annual documented vendor reviews are the standard CC9.2 artifact.
